prospect_company: African Institute for Policy Research and Dialogue
ungm_status: Yes - Level 1; UNGM ID 378538; USAID partner evidence in prospect DB
benchmark_tender_or_agency: UNICEF/UNFPA/UNDP policy research and evidence-to-policy technical assistance in Africa
scenario_goal: Assess whether a policy-research RFP is worth pursuing and produce a decision memo tied to sector, geography, eligibility, evidence and effort.
expected_primary_win: Decisive pursue / conditional / skip recommendation with evidence-backed fit, blockers, required docs and next action.
public_inputs_available: Official AFIDEP about and approach pages; prospect DB UNGM/USAID notes; public UNGM/UNICEF/UNDP procurement context.
missing_inputs: Actual TOR, eligibility criteria, audited financials, staff CVs, recent donor references, price basis.
key_failure_points: Likely relevant assessment, but dashboard-to-paid path depends on persisted pipeline context. Without exact TOR, bid/no-bid can become a good fit narrative instead of a decision.
highest_leverage_fix: Carry the selected tender, source URL, match reasons and assessment evidence directly into the paid memo; require or extract eligibility criteria before checkout.
notes: Strong vendor proof. TenderPath can remove search and first-pass qualification work, but not yet enough compliance evidence to feel like a final bid-room decision.

notes: Very good ICP. The value is strongest when TenderPath translates public project evidence into a bid/no-bid memo with caveats, not when it simply says 'environmental consultancy match'.
